tools.name: skavio_launch_status
tools.title: Launch status
tools.description: Free production availability status, including explicitly disabled processing functions. No execution or charge. Returns enabled/admission flags and unverified funded-execution/margin status; activation is not funded acceptance.

tools.name: domain_dns_tls_audit
tools.title: Public domain DNS and TLS audit
tools.description: Bounded DNS and TLS certificate audit for a single PUBLIC business hostname. Checks public IPs, TLS validity, TLS version and days until certificate expiry. No page scraping, no user-provided URLs, no private IP probing. $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Input example: example.com. Performs bounded public DNS resolution and one pinned TLS handshake on port 443, no HTTP request. Reports tls_valid, public IPs and certificate details; not a vulnerability scan or trust certification.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname, for example example.com; no URL, IP, credentials or private host.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Web fetch
tools.description: Search public Google results with Serper or securely fetch one public HTTPS page. Optional DeepSeek structured diagnostic. Separate authenticated Agent Tools relay: requires your own company Bearer API key. URL and query are mutually exclusive. Prepaid uses the shared company credit wallet; x402 produces a workload-specific payment quote. Preserve the same idempotency key, arguments and payment mode on retry; admission is not delivery. Poll job status and fetch result with SHA256 verification.

diagnose.description: Optional DeepSeek interpretation, priced separately; a provider failure never loses the primary result.

max_results.description: Search results to return in query mode.

query.description: Google query answered by Serper; returns real source URLs, never synthesised links. Mutually exclusive with url.

url.description: Public HTTPS page to process. Mutually exclusive with query.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Stable job key; retry exactly the same inputs and payment mode with this key to recover safely.

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode
payment_mode.description: x402 returns a workload-specific quote; prepaid spends your existing shared company credits. No anonymous execution.

io.skavio/result-schema.description: PaymentRequired, durable job admission, or explicit error. Admission is not delivery; poll owned status then result and verify SHA256.

error.description: Explicit failure code; no success/delivery implied.

_meta.io.skavio/authentication: Agent Tools Bearer API key. Operation availability and admission are checked by the customer backend.
